text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Three central bank officials and two other suspects arraigned before failed banks tribunal accused of stealing 257 million naira belonging to federal government.
- Three prominent politicians from southwestern Oshun state ordered to refund 150 million naira to government coffers by next Monday and banned from holding public office for six years.
- Taiwan, which has no diplomatic relations with Nigeria, woos Nigerian businessmen; wants them to enter into joint ventures in Nigeria on liberial terms.
- Nigeria and China sign memorandum of understanding for Chinese company to participate in national housing programme to build more than 120,000 homes.
